content:
Following continued price drops on AirPods Pro 3 and the all-time low of $20 per AirTag 2, preorders for the all-new M6 Mac mini are now back in stock at Amazon, and we've also detailed some trade-in deals worth noting. Additionally, today we have Amazon's highest-quality Premium Renewed iPhone 17 Pro in stock with up to $290 off, plus an excellent deal on one of my all-time favorite chargers — the Anker Prime power bank with display that doubles as a wall charger. Read on for all the great deals.

One of the best Apple deals of the year: brand new 2026 AirTag 2 now from just $20 each

  • AirTag 2 $24 (originally $29) — new all-time low
  • AirTag 2 four-pack $80 (originally $99) — brand new all-time low
  • AirPods Pro 3 $200 (originally $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (originally $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (originally $129)

Brand new M6 and M5 Pro Mac mini preorders now back in stock at Amazon

Apple officially unveiled and opened preorders today for the upgraded M6 Mac mini alongside the M5 Pro model, and preorders have also begun landing at Amazon. Before you place your order, don't forget about the new-generation Apple Polishing Cloth for just $9 — don't wait until it's cleared out.

Apple also launched today the first Mac powered by the all-new M6 chip along with the upgraded M5 Pro Mac mini, now available for preorder at Amazon:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB $899
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,099
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,299
  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB $1,699

With the previous-generation M4 series essentially sold out across retail channels, the all-new M6 and M5 Pro models are now fully back in stock at Amazon, though whether Apple can maintain steady supply remains uncertain (the Neo situation was clearly quite a struggle back then).

Best Buy offering up to $500 off M6 Mac mini with M4 trade-in, members get double rewards

Apple's official Bumper case drops to an all-time low under $13 (32% off)

Attention iPhone Air users — Apple's official Bumper case has now plunged to an all-time low under $13 at Amazon, with free shipping for Prime members.

Amazon is currently selling the official Apple iPhone Air Bumper case, with free shipping for Prime members or orders over $35, priced as low as $12.64.

The light blue variant is priced below $13, a massive 68% discount off the original $39, setting an all-time low record on Amazon. Other colorways are priced slightly higher, and the black version has already sold out entirely — at this price, the light blue variant could be next to go out of stock.

Yes, this is just a minimalist Bumper case wrapping around the edges of the device, but we're talking about clearance pricing on an official Apple accessory. It lets the design of your phone shine through while providing just the right amount of protection for users who only need basic coverage — though note that it only protects the edges, not the screen or camera module.

Just picked up a new Mac mini or Mac Studio? Here are the best monitors to pair with them

Amazon's highest-quality Premium Renewed iPhone 17 Pro in stock with $220 off (matches Prime Day deal)

While Apple's official certified refurbished store has always been my go-to platform for finding iPhone bargains, Apple has yet to list the latest iPhone 17 Pro models there — it looks like we'll have to wait until next month after the 18 series launches before stock arrives. Amazon's highest-quality Premium Renewed inventory has now returned to its Prime Day deal pricing, saving you up to $220 off the brand new original price.

Amazon's high-quality Premium Renewed models have always been the most affordable way to get an unlocked iPhone 17 Pro. Besides saving hundreds of dollars, buyers also receive a 1-year Amazon Renewed guarantee and an assurance of "greater than 90% original battery life" — other non-"Premium" refurbished units on Amazon only come with a 90-day warranty and the battery health is in a completely different league.

Both the 1TB and 512GB iPhone 17 Pro models are back in stock now with up to $220 off — the 512GB version is an additional $20 lower than the deal previously mentioned:

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,215 (originally $1,499 new) — all-time low
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,215 (originally $1,499 new) — all-time low
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,208 (originally $1,499 new) — all-time low
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,166 (originally $1,299 new) — all-time low
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,171 (originally $1,299 new) — all-time low
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,170 (originally $1,299 new) — all-time low

Anker Prime power bank doubles as wall charger: my favorite portable charger now down to $70

Anker and other brands do indeed offer plenty of higher-wattage (or higher-capacity) power banks, but this Anker Prime 9,600mAh model has always been my favorite. Now down to $70, it features not only a built-in display but also integrated foldable prongs, effectively doubling as a wall charger.

Anker's official Amazon store is currently selling this 9,600mAh Prime power bank for $69.99 with free shipping.

Originally priced at $90, today's deal matches both the pricing we previously mentioned and the official Prime Day price in June, making it the lowest price of the year on Amazon.

To reiterate, while there are plenty of high-capacity power bank options on the market, this one has always been the most practical piece in my kit. It's much lighter than high-capacity models, yet the power is enough to last a full day of charging my phone and MacBook, and its biggest highlight is the integrated foldable prongs — a feature many other brands' products simply can't match.

In other words, with the foldable prongs on the back, you don't need to carry an additional wall charger to top up the internal battery — just plug it directly into a wall outlet. While charging, it can also simultaneously charge your device.

Beyond the above features, you'll also find a pair of USB-C ports and Anker's built-in 1.3-inch smart display:

The package includes a 2-year warranty, a USB-C cable (100W, braided) and a portable carrying pouch.

Anker 7-in-1 Nano charging dock with retractable USB-C and smart display, down to $60 (25% off)

Anker MagSafe power bank this week from just $36 with free shipping (multiple colors available)

Tim Cook's legacy adds another gem: new-generation Apple Polishing Cloth officially launched, priced at $9

Today's accessories and charger deals roundup:

  • Mini 65W Anker charger can replace multiple charging bricks, today only $24
  • Pair the all-new M6 Mac mini with Samsung's 37-inch 4K ViewFinity S8 monitor, down to an all-time low of $320
  • Equip your vehicle with a 175W USB-C car charger, now $20
  • Latest Moto Tag 2 with Find Hub support and UWB, Amazon low of $17.50 each
  • Satechi transparent 4-in-1 USB-C travel hub with 4K HDMI, down to $38
  • Perfect timing to pair with the all-new M6 Mac mini: Samsung's value-packed 32-inch Smart Monitor returns to low price of $180
  • Organize your desk with Anker's clever clamp-on power strip, now down to $58

Twelve South TimePorter Apple Watch band organizer at $21 with Prime shipping, setting a yearly low

Anker's brand new SmartTrack Find My wallet card supports iOS or Android, down to $25 setting Amazon all-time low

Anker recently launched its brand new SmartTrack Find My Card wallet tracker — the first product to support both Apple's tracking platform and Google Find Hub — now on sale at an Amazon all-time low of $25 with Prime shipping.

Anker's EufyHome official Amazon store is currently selling the new SmartTrack Card E40 for $24.99, compatible with iOS or Android, with free shipping for Prime members or orders over $35.

When this product first landed on Amazon last month it was priced at $35, and after a slight $5 discount at the end of the month, it's now seeing its first significant price cut, setting an Amazon all-time low.

This discount is nearly 30% off, matching the pricing with the best deals we've tracked this year on similar wallet tracker cards.

I'm personally a huge fan of the Nomad Tracking Card — the standard version starts at $35, while the Pro version with up to 16 months of battery life before needing a recharge is priced at $45 — but regardless of which one you choose, I believe everyone should have one of these products in their wallet or card holder; I personally never leave home without mine.

This Anker SmartTrack Card E40 comes with all the most important features, including wireless charging, and is compatible with both the Apple Find My platform or Google Find Hub. At only 1.7mm thick, the ringtone volume can reach 80 decibels for locating your wallet at close range — and of course, it can also connect directly to the Find My and Find Hub apps to display its location on a map.
